summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, Chunghwa Digital Cultural and Creative Capital Co., acquired a right-of-use asset (an office lease) from the parent company. The transaction involves 60.87 ping at NT$2,107 per ping per month for a two-year term, totaling NT$3,078,072. The board approved the related-party lease for business planning, with no advisory or appraisal noted. This is an internal asset transfer, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
